μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀχῆα: ’long’ (μακρὸν ὀχῆα ’the long bar’)
μαχέσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. inf. mid., epic: ’to fight’
μαχησόμενος: μάχομαι — fight; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -ησ- (= Attic μαχεσόμενος), of purpose: ’to fight’
μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’) · also prep. + acc., ’among, into the midst of’ (μεθ’ ὅμιλον ’among the throng’)
μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μενοιτιάδῃ: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
μεσσαύλοιο: μέσσαυλος — farmyard, steading; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of separation after ἀπό: ’from the farmyard’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνήσασθε: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’be mindful of’
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέκυν: νέκυς — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
ναιετάουσι: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι); of cities, ’are inhabited’
νεκρὸν: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νωλεμὲς: νωλεμής — unceasing, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly, without a break’
νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; adj., masc. nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’such as (my might) is’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with an unspoken με: ’such as (I was) when’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔρνος, correlative of τοῖον: ’such as (a shoot)’
οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -σι (= Attic οἷς): ’to whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own, its own’; neut. dat. pl. (οἷσι τέκεσσι ’its own young’) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: masc. dat. pl., ’his own’ (οἷσι πόδεσσι ’on his own feet’)
οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. acc. sg. relative, correlative with τοῖον: ’such (a thing) as’ · also adverbial, + τε: ’such as, like’ · also οἷόν τε + inf.: ’such as to, able to’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τινά: ’such (a man) as’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg., with μάχης · also fem. gen. sg., with ὁμηλικίης: ’all’ (περὶ πάσης ὁμηλικίης ’above all his age-mates’)
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’grief’
πέπον: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. sg.
πέφατ: φένω — slay; perf. pass. 3 sg., elided (πέφατ’ = πέφαται): ’has been slain’
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg., after ξύν · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of δόμεν: ’to her child’ · also masc. dat. sg., after περί, of place or concern: ’around’ (φίλῳ περὶ παιδί ’around his dear son’)
παπταίνων: παπταίνω — look about, peer around; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’
παριστάμενος: παρίστημι — set beside; mid. stand beside; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’standing beside’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
πελώριον: πελώριος — huge, monstrous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα: ’huge’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’huge’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πεφήσεται: φένω — slay; fut. pass. 3 sg., reduplicated epic future: ’will be slain’
πηλεΐδεω: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic Πηλείδου)
πηλεΐωνος: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with φῦκος: ’much (seaweed)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱδρῶ: ’much (sweat)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with τρόφι: ’greatly’ (πολλὸν … τρόφι ’greatly swollen’)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adv. in tmesis with a verb of following: ’along with it’ (προτὶ … ἕποντο ’followed along with it’)
πτόλιος: πτόλις (epic for πόλις) — city; fem. gen. sg. (= Attic πόλεως)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’much, greatly’ (πόλλ’ ἀεκαζομένη ’much against her will’)
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πύργον: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. acc. sg.
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’ · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), attributive with a subject: ’the whole’ (πᾶν ξίφος ’the whole sword’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἄρξομαι: ’from you’ (σέο … ἄρξομαι ’I shall begin from you’) · also gen. sg. after ἕξεται: ’on you’ (σέο … ἕξεται ’will rest on you’) · also gen. sg. after ἐκ: ’from you’ (σέο δ’ ἐκ ’and from you’)
σαρπηδόνος: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, Lycian prince and ally of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στίχες: στίξ — rank, line of men; fem. nom. pl.
σταθμοῖο: σταθμός — stall, fold, steading (also door-post, jamb); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), of separation
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάμοι: τέμνω — cut; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic strong aor. (= Attic τέμοι): ’may he cut off’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι)
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιον: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon, Telamonian; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων)
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)

ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰλίῳ: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Ilium’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱππολόχοιο: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱρὴν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρήν (= Attic ἱεράν) · also Ἱρή — Hire, a town; fem. acc. sg. (proper name)
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὁτὲ: ὁτέ (= τοτέ) — at one time, now; adv., correlative ὁτὲ μέν … ἄλλοτε δέ ’at one time … at another’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρος: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. nom. sg.
ὄπασσε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, send along; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὤπασε): ’gave’
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — turn over in the mind, ponder; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὥρμαινε): ’pondered’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὑπέροπλον: ὑπέροπλος — arrogant, overbearing (formation not clear); adj., neut. acc. sg., used as an adverb: ’arrogantly’
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὕλῃ: Ὕλη — Hyle, a town in Boeotia (the same word as ὕλη ’woodland’); fem. dat. sg., of place · also ὕλη — woodland, forest; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀξύλῳ: ’thick woodland’
ὠνοσάμην: ὄνομαι — find fault with, make light of; aor. 1 sg. mid. (augmented): ’I found fault with’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also masc. dual dat., of place with εἱμένος: ’about the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν νεφέλην ’a cloud about the shoulders’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
